page_title: ELC 1-1 BET | Elche v Betis 18/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The players claim that Cedric Bakambu (Betis) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Elche will take a free kick near the side line.
86' John Donald (Elche) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. It's a free kick to Betis in a dangerous position.
86' Victor Garcia blows his whistle. Rafa Mir (Elche) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Betis.
84' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Cucho Hernandez will be replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Natan (Betis) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and German Valera walks off the pitch to be replaced by John Donald (Elche).
81' 1 - 1 Goal! Martim Neto slips a clever pass through to German Valera (Elche), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
78' The referee blows for a cooling break.
75' Wow, what an escape. Chimy Avila (Betis) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
73' The substitution is prepared. Rafa Mir (Elche) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Leo Petrot.
71' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Pablo Garcia (Betis) replaces Aitor Ruibal.
70' Substitution. Rodrigo Riquelme will be replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).

68' Fine attempt! Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
65' Here comes a substitution. Marc Aguado is given a rest as he is replaced by Jairo Izquierdo (Elche).
65' Eder Sarabia prepares a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez is replaced by Mourad El Ghezouani (Elche).
65' That will be all from Ali Houary who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Martim Neto (Elche).
61' German Valera (Elche) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Pau Lopez makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
60' Having seen unsporting behavior, Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Eder Sarabia (Elche) is the recipient.

60' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.

57' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Elche.
57' The corner is swung in but Betis can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Betis.
56' Betis take a short corner kick.
54' Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul after Aleix Febas (Elche) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick to Betis.
53' David Affengruber (Elche) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Victor Garcia blows for a foul. Betis earn a free kick.
53' Pedro Bigas (Elche) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Betis are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
48' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
47' It looks like Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) saw red with that tackle. Victor Garcia won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Betis are awarded the free kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' German Valera (Elche) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.

45+1' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Elche have a free kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' David Affengruber (Elche) jumps into a tackle and Victor Garcia signals a foul. It's a free kick to Betis, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
43' A quickly taken corner by Elche.
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Elche, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Elche will have a corner.
42' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Hector Bellerin (Betis) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Elche.

38' Leo Petrot (Elche) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.

33' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Elche are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
30' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
27' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Elche have a free kick.
23' Natan (Betis) was too forceful with his tackle and Victor Garcia interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Elche.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Rodrigo Riquelme slips in Aitor Ruibal (Betis) for a one-on-one with the keeper, and he simply dinks the ball over him into the net.
17' Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Marc Aguado (Elche) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Betis, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
12' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Matias Dituro (Elche).

11' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Matias Dituro shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
10' Two players stand over the free kick. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.

9' David Affengruber (Elche) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Victor Garcia stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Betis have a free kick from a promising distance.
3' Elche are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Elche will take the kick-off.
Victor Garcia was nominated as the referee for this game.
